operating_notes.text: Midwest was selected as Lead Consortium Partner by KMML for a monazite-tailings rare earth pilot, with 100% capex by Midwest and a right of first refusal for commercial production; size not quantifiable at this stage.
As of 31 March 2026, unutilised IPO proceeds stood at ₹167.88 Cr out of ₹229.63 Cr net proceeds.
FY26 consolidated cash from operations was ₹174.72 Cr, 164% of net profit of ₹106.48 Cr, with capex of ₹129.96 Cr.
Q4FY26 revenue of ₹215.81 Cr was 67.5% above Q3FY26's ₹128.86 Cr, with EBITDA margin recovering to 27.03% from 23.7%.
Midwest has been selected as Lead Consortium Partner by KMML for a rare earth pilot plant.
Quartz Phase 1 installed capacity is 300,000 tonnes, with 240,000-250,000 tonnes treated as peak; Phase 1 is 70% engineered stone (₹9,000-14,500/t) and 30% solar (about ₹7,000/t).
Q4FY26 Quartz sales were about 1,000-plus tonnes for ₹1.8 Cr turnover, with 3,000-4,000 tonnes produced but reprocessed for quality.
Diamond wire segment revenue was about ₹25 Cr versus ₹16 Cr, at roughly 15% PBT margin.
Board approved a wholly owned Singapore subsidiary to act as intermediate holding and investment entity for overseas operations, with 100% of share capital held by the Company.
The Singapore entity is yet to be incorporated and is intended for overseas holding and investment in heavy mineral sands, rare earth materials, mineral trading and processing.

timeline.summary: On 22 April 2026 promoter Rama Raghava Reddy Kollareddy gifted 14,08,851 Midwest shares (3.90%) to promoter-group relative Kollareddy Ranganayakamma, leaving the group's aggregate holding unchanged.

On 6 May 2026 Midwest said KMML, a Government of Kerala undertaking, selected it as Lead Consortium Partner for a rare earth pilot plant, subject to an MoU and approvals, with 100% capex by Midwest and a right of first refusal on commercial production.
On 15 May 2026, Midwest Limited released the Monitoring Agency Report from Crisil Ratings for the quarter ended 31 March 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹215.81 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹35.55 Cr.
On 27 May 2026, Midwest Limited released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation detailing strong sequential growth and rare earth diversification.
KOLLAREDDY RAMACHANDRA, Whole-time Director, notified the exchange of the earnings conference call audio recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 on May 27, 2026.

On 30 May 2026 Midwest filed the transcript of its 27 May Q4FY26 call: granite FY26 EBITDA margin 27.55%, Quartz Phase 2 capex ₹125-130 Cr for Q4FY27, KMML rare earth pilot budget ₹20 Cr, and a 3-4 year vision of ₹1,000 Cr granite plus ₹1,100 Cr from new projects.

On 15 October 2026, Midwest's board approved setting up a 100% owned Singapore holding and investment subsidiary for overseas heavy mineral sands, rare earth and mineral trading operations, yet to be incorporated.
